fields.description: Run the weighbridge comparison on driver confirmation
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Block driver confirmation when a truck is outside tolerance. Leave off to record variances without blocking anyone.
fields.label: Enforce (block out-of-tolerance trucks)

fields.description: Allowed variance as a percentage of the expected load
fields.label: Tolerance (%)

fields.description: Minimum allowed variance in Kg. Used when the percentage works out smaller than this, so small loads are not flagged by scale noise.
fields.label: Tolerance Floor (Kg)

fields.description: Maximum hours between the empty and loaded readings for them to count as one truck visit
fields.label: Maximum Visit Window (Hours)

fields.options: Weight of one unit of anything that is not already measured in Kg — crates, packaging, tubs. Rows matched on Item Code win over rows matched on Item Group. Lines whose stock UOM is already Kg do not need an entry. Item master weight_per_unit is deliberately not used: on fish items it holds crate capacity, not weight.
